name: Ba Duan Jin · 八段锦
summary:
Bring a quiet Ba Duan Jin practice space into your headset.

Follow all eight traditional movements with a life-size stereoscopic video instructor in a landscaped virtual courtyard. Start with any section, pause to review a movement, replay a section, or continue through the sequence.

Features:
• All eight demonstration sections included.
• Stereoscopic instructor video with original Chinese audio.
• A mixed-reality selection menu and an immersive practice courtyard.
